description: AgroVision AI Canonical Crop Registry establishing authoritative crop identifiers, supported plant organs, associated canonical disease IDs, dataset provenance, and evidence-based verification statuses.

crops.regional_relevance: Temperate zones (Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir). Minimal commercial cultivation in Southern India plains.
evidence_references: ICAR-CITH (Central Institute of Temperate Horticulture) Apple Disease Compendium 2022
PlantVillage dataset publication (Mohanty et al., 2016)
crops.status_justification: Represented only by 280 laboratory cardboard images in Dataset 1. Zero real-world field images available in Dataset 2 or regional farm surveys. Phase 8 independent test accuracy in unified model was low (30.8% broad set).

crops.regional_relevance: Major cash crop in Andhra Pradesh (Krishna, Guntur, Kadapa, East/West Godavari), Tamil Nadu, and Maharashtra.
evidence_references: ICAR-NRCB (National Research Centre for Banana) Disease Management Guide 2023
ANGRAU Package of Practices for Horticultural Crops (Banana Protection) 2024
crops.status_justification: Represented by 1,842 real-world field photographs in Dataset 2. Evaluated on 276 locked field test images with 89.13% independent accuracy.

crops.regional_relevance: Premier commercial spice crop in Guntur, Prakasam, Khammam, and Warangal (major export belt).
evidence_references: ANGRAU Vyavasaya Panchangam (Chilli IPM Guidelines) 2024
ICAR-IIHR (Indian Institute of Horticultural Research) Chilli Pest & Disease Bulletin 2022
crops.status_justification: Represented by 3,363 outdoor field photographs in Dataset 2 across 7 canonical classes. Evaluated on 462 independent test images with 86.15% accuracy. Excluded ambiguous class Chilli_Yellowish.

crops.regional_relevance: Widely cultivated kharif/rabi cereal in Telangana (Nizamabad, Karimnagar) and Andhra Pradesh (Kurnool, Guntur).
evidence_references: ICAR-IIMR (Indian Institute of Maize Research) Disease Atlas 2023
PJTSAU Maize Diagnostic Key and IPM Manual 2023
crops.status_justification: Dataset 1 contains 280 leaf images on laboratory cardboard. Dataset 2 has zero corn images. Active interface erroneously rejects ears/cobs due to foliar-only validation. Requires organ-aware validation and field data.

crops.regional_relevance: Primary commercial cash crop in black cotton soils of Adilabad, Guntur, Kurnool, Warangal.
evidence_references: ICAR-CICR (Central Institute for Cotton Research) Cotton Disease Identification Guide 2023
ANGRAU Cotton IPM Package of Practices 2024
crops.status_justification: Represented by 2,570 combined images (Dataset 1 and Dataset 2). Tested on 396 independent field test records with 88.64% accuracy.

crops.regional_relevance: Cultivated in Maharashtra (Nashik), Karnataka (Vijayapura), and peri-urban Hyderabad (Anab-e-Shahi).
evidence_references: ICAR-NRCG (National Research Centre for Grapes) Crop Protection Manual 2023
PlantVillage laboratory reference set (Hughes & Salathe, 2015)
crops.status_justification: Dataset 1 contains 280 laboratory cardboard leaf images. Zero field vineyard photographs present in Dataset 2.

crops.regional_relevance: Leading perennial fruit crop in Andhra Pradesh (Krishna Banganapalle, Chittoor Totapuri, Visakhapatnam).
evidence_references: ICAR-CISH (Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture) Mango Protection Guide 2023
Dr. YSR Horticultural University (YSRHU) Mango Pest & Disease Manual 2024
crops.status_justification: Represented by 4,000 real-world orchard images in Dataset 2 across 8 canonical classes. Evaluated on 675 field test records with 91.41% accuracy.

crops.regional_relevance: Rapidly expanding irrigated plantation crop in coastal Andhra Pradesh (West Godavari, East Godavari).
evidence_references: ICAR-IIOPR (Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research, Pedavegi) Diagnostic Field Guide 2023
crops.status_justification: Dataset 2 contains only 296 total palm images with severe imbalance (Scale Insect 142, Mg Deficiency 59). Two classes (Palm_Dryness, Palm_Fungal Disease) excluded due to lack of specificity. No healthy palm baseline class in dataset.

crops.regional_relevance: Sweet orange (Battayi) majorly grown in Rayalaseema (Anantapur, Kadapa) and Nalgonda.
evidence_references: ICAR-CCRI (Central Citrus Research Institute) Huanglongbing Diagnostic Key 2022
ANGRAU Sweet Orange Protection Protocols 2023
crops.status_justification: Represented only by 140 laboratory leaf images in Dataset 1. Only 1 disease condition (Huanglongbing/Greening) present.

crops.regional_relevance: Protected cultivation / polyhouse crop in peri-urban areas. Distinguished taxonomically from field hot chilli.
evidence_references: PlantVillage benchmark taxonomy (Mohanty et al., 2016)
TNAU Agritech Portal Greenhouse Pepper Production 2023
crops.status_justification: Dataset 1 contains 140 laboratory cardboard images. Must not be conflated with open-field hot chilli (*Capsicum annuum* hot cultivars).

crops.regional_relevance: Major horticultural tuber crop in Indo-Gangetic plains, Hassan (Karnataka), and Medak (Telangana).
evidence_references: ICAR-CPRI (Central Potato Research Institute) Technical Bulletin 2023
FAO Late Blight Management Protocol 2021
crops.status_justification: Represented only by 210 laboratory cardboard images in Dataset 1. Zero field images in Dataset 2. Prime root cause of field misclassification: field potato leaves are falsely classified as healthy chilli due to class volume imbalance.

crops.regional_relevance: Primary staple food crop across Andhra Pradesh (Godavari & Krishna deltas) and Telangana.
evidence_references: ICAR-IIRR (Indian Institute of Rice Research, Hyderabad) Rice IPM Manual 2023
ANGRAU Rice Production and Protection Guidelines 2024
IRRI (International Rice Research Institute) Rice Knowledge Bank
crops.status_justification: Represented by 3,670 combined images across 8 canonical classes. Evaluated on 550 independent test records with 84.55% accuracy. Corrected Phase 1 metadata defect (Bacterial Leaf Blight properly designated as bacterial).

crops.regional_relevance: Major horticultural vegetable crop across Madanapalle (Chittoor - largest tomato market in Asia), Rangareddy, and Kolar.
evidence_references: ICAR-IIHR Tomato Disease & Pest Management Guide 2023
ANGRAU Package of Practices for Vegetable Crops 2024
crops.status_justification: Represented by 5,573 combined images across 10 canonical classes. High sample count across both datasets. Evaluated on independent test sets.

crops.regional_relevance: Major commercial cash crop in Nizamabad, Duggirala (Guntur), and Kadapa.
evidence_references: ICAR-IISR (Indian Institute of Spices Research) Turmeric Compendium 2023
ANGRAU Turmeric Protection Bulletins 2024
crops.status_justification: Represented by 781 real-world field photographs in Dataset 2. Evaluated on 117 independent test records with 87.18% accuracy. Crucially supports non-foliar organ diagnosis (rhizome rot on fingers/mother rhizome).

crops.regional_relevance: Rabi cereal crop in Northern/Central India (Punjab, Haryana, MP, UP). Minimal cultivation in South India plains.
evidence_references: ICAR-IIWBR (Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research, Karnal) Disease Management Manual 2023
crops.status_justification: Dataset 1 contains 280 laboratory cardboard images. Zero field wheat images present in Dataset 2.

crops.regional_relevance: Negative control category for out-of-distribution rejection.
evidence_references: AgroVision AI Baseline Evaluation and OOD Rejection Protocol 2026
crops.status_justification: Negative rejection class containing 70 non-plant baseline images (tools, soil, hands, buildings). Used strictly for selective prediction abstention.
